recent_events.headline: Fed holds rates steady, signals one more cut likely in 2026
recent_events.plain_summary: The Fed left interest rates where they are, and hinted that one small rate cut may come later this year — mildly good for bonds, no urgent action for most people.

recent_events.headline: Tech sector rally pauses as AI chip valuations face scrutiny
recent_events.plain_summary: AI-heavy tech stocks like NVIDIA are taking a breather after a long run up — investors are asking if prices got ahead of themselves. Normal pullback, not a crash.

recent_events.headline: Q1 GDP beats estimates at 2.8% growth
recent_events.plain_summary: The US economy grew a bit faster than expected this quarter — quietly good news, suggesting we're avoiding a sharp slowdown.
